Game Overview

At its heart, Snake Eats Apples is a snake game about guide a hungry snake through an endless challenge, collecting apples as you navigate with intuitive touch or keyboard controls. Each apple boosts your score, but watch out—the game gets progressively harder! How many can you eat before the pace overwhelms you? Aim for a new high score!
